# Currently Available APIs

_Metadata Search API_

- Query and retrieve metadata records including abstracts for more than 6 million documents in IEEE Xplore® including Journals, Conference Proceedings, Books, Courses and Standards. The Metadata API supports both [simple](https://developer.ieee.org/docs/read/Metadata_API_details) and [Boolean searches](https://developer.ieee.org/docs/read/metadata_api_details/Leveraging_Boolean_Logic).

_IEEE Open Access API_

- Query and retrieve full-text articles designated as Open Access as well as chargeable Full-Text.

_IEEE Full-Text Access API_

- Query and retrieve full-text articles designated as chargeable.

_Digital Object Identifier (DOI) API_

- Query up to 25 DOI (Digital Object Identifier) numbers and retrieve metadata records including abstracts.
